# Laevitas browser terminal

Production: https://terminal.laevitas.ch
Development (test networks): https://terminal.devitas.ch
Installed CLI: https://cli.laevitas.ch
Docs: https://github.com/Laevitas/cli/blob/main/docs/browser-terminal.md
Free production product catalog: https://apiv2.laevitas.ch/api/v1/agents/catalog
Free synthetic sample: https://apiv2.laevitas.ch/api/v1/agents/sandbox/market-snapshot
Build/version metadata: /build.json

This website runs the actual released CLI as WebAssembly in a browser Worker.
Browser agents can await window.laevitasTerminal.run({args:["agent","catalog"]}).
Returns stdout, stderr, exitCode and parsed json when stdout is JSON.
Discover commands with args:["commands"]. One command at a time.
Connect Base or Solana with args:["agent","login"] and the owner's wallet approval.
Never provide a private key or seed phrase. Credentials stay in tab memory.
Starter credits require a verified eligible wallet: args:["agent","claim"].
Inspect credits with args:["agent","balance"], usage with args:["agent","usage"].
REST data consumes existing credits. HTTP 402 stops; the browser never pays.
Payment signing, local files, streaming, TUI, stdio MCP and 6022 partner calls
require the installed CLI. Enterprise API keys require an active entitlement.
This is not an A2A conversation node and does not publish a signed Agent Card.
